newsitem.title: USA: Farmers to sell homeowners policies in California.
newsitem.headline: Farmers to sell homeowners policies in California.

text.p: Farmers Insurance said on Wednesday that it would begin selling new homeowners' policies in California beginning December 1.
In a statement, Farmers said the move ends the moratorium that was in place since June 1994, following the devastating losses from the Northridge earthquake.
Farmers is a unit of B.A.T Industries Plc.
Farmers said its reentry into the homeowners market coincides with the confirmed implementation of the California Earthquake Authority, effective December 1.

Farmers' reentry into the homeowners market will occur throughout the state, with few restrictions. However, Farmers said it will continue to prudently manage its overall exposure to all catastrophic losses.
Farmers began selling new renters policies without restrictions in November.
Farmers is California's third-largest home insurer and the second-largest property and casualty insurance group in the state.
